notes_for_human: Neither undergraduate program's official newyorkfed.org page states a citizenship/work-authorization requirement — both are silent on the program-overview page itself (confirmed by direct read on 2026-07-29). That clause instead appears on individual job requisitions (hosted via the Bank's applicant-tracking system and mirrored on third-party boards like BuiltIn). One such 2026-cycle requisition (https://builtin.com/job/2026-summer-intern-research-group-sophomore/7175915, a Sophomore/Research Group posting) states verbatim: 'Access to CSI and FOMC information is limited to U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, individuals who meet the definition of "protected individual" under 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3), and certain other nonimmigrants,' with non-citizens required to 'sign a declaration of intent to expeditiously become a lawful permanent resident and thereafter a U.S. citizen when eligible.' This is a hedge tied to roles requiring CSI/FOMC access, not a blanket citizenship mandate for every intern role, and it is drawn from the 2026 cycle, not confirmed as applying verbatim to 2027 — hence 'unverified' rather than 'stated' in the JSON above. The same 2026 posting also gave a class-year cutoff ('expected graduation date of Winter 2026 or Spring 2027') and an application deadline ('October 5th, 2025, 11:59 PM EST') — both cycle-specific and not usable as 2027 facts. Both official pages uniformly say 2027 program details will be posted 'in September 2026.' WebFetch was blocked (403) on newyorkfed.org domain generally; all successful primary-source reads used the browser tool instead.
